description: rc.8 (F-02): a 0.0.7 guardrails.max_retries is merged into the declared guardrails.limit member by member, never replacing it: limit.seconds (0.5) and limit.cost_usd survive beside the mapped limit.retries, and the supervisor kills the 5 s step and returns 124. Before the fix the mapped {retries: 0} replaced the declared limit and the step ran to completion (code 0).
